name: peapod
description: Peapod — a shared-life app for pods (couples, families, close friend groups). Polyglot monorepo: Expo/React Native client, Node API, Python security service, Rust compute service.

scripts.//--- contract ---: The shared package is the single source of truth for types. Build it before anything that imports it.
scripts.//--- infrastructure ---: Postgres is the only required container. Compute (Rust) is optional; the API falls back to TypeScript.
scripts.infra:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d postgres
scripts.//--- database ---: Drizzle owns the schema; migrations are generated from services/api/src/db/schema.ts.
scripts.//--- development ---: Run each service in its own terminal, or use dev:all to start the Node + Python services together.
scripts.//--- quality gates ---: Run these before finishing any change.
scripts.test:health: npm run test:health --workspace @peapod/api && npm run test:health --workspace @peapod/mobile
scripts.check: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck && npm run lint
